tool_input.command: cat data/schema.md; echo "---TRAIN---"; head -5 data/features_train.csv; echo "..."; wc -l data/features_train.csv; echo "---SERVE---"; head -5 data/features_serve.csv; wc -l data/features_serve.csv
hops --help 2>&1 | head -60
hops fg --help 2>&1
hops fg create --help 2>&1; echo "====INSERT===="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1
tool_input.description: Show fg create and insert help

tool_input.command: hops sql --help 2>&1; echo "====TRINO===="; hops trino --help 2>&1 | head -40
hops context 2>&1 | head -30

hops fg create raw_train_f3dc5 --version 1 --primary-key row_id \
  --features "row_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double" \
  --description "Raw training split staging" --json 2>&1 | tail -20

hops fg create raw_serve_f3dc5 --version 1 --primary-key row_id \
  --features "row_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double" \
  --description "Raw serving split staging" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg list --json 2>&1 | grep -iE '"name"|version' | head -40
hops fg insert raw_train_f3dc5 --version 1 --file data/features_train.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -15
hops fg insert raw_serve_f3dc5 --version 1 --file data/features_serve.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -8
hops trino tables mlpabf15770 --json 2>&1 | grep -iE 'raw_|f3dc5' | head; echo "---describe---"; hops trino describe "raw_train_f3dc5_1" 2>&1 | tail -15

tool_input.command: hops trino tables mlpabf15770 2>&1 | tail -20
hops trino tables mlpabf15770 --no-verify 2>&1 | grep -iE 'raw_|f3dc5|train|serve'
hops trino tables mlpabf15770 --no-verify 2>&1 | tail -30
hops trino catalogs --no-verify 2>&1 | tail -20
hops trino tables hive.mlpabf15770 --no-verify 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "===HUDI==="; hops trino tables hudi.mlpabf15770 --no-verify 2>&1 | tail -10
tool_input.description: List tables in hive and hudi catalogs

tool_input.command: hops trino schemas hive --no-verify 2>&1 | tail -25
hops trino tables hive.mlpabf15770_featurestore --no-verify 2>&1 | tail -15

hops sql --no-verify --catalog hive --schema mlpabf15770_featurestore --json "
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT avg(f1) m1, avg(f2) m2, avg(f3) m3, avg(f4) m4,
         stddev_pop(f1) s1, stddev_pop(f2) s2, stddev_pop(f3) s3, stddev_pop(f4) s4
  FROM raw_train_f3dc5_1
),
allrows AS (
  SELECT row_id, 'train' AS split, f1,f2,f3,f4 FROM raw_train_f3dc5_1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT row_id, 'serve' AS split, f1,f2,f3,f4 FROM raw_serve_f3dc5_1
)
SELECT a.row_id, a.split,
  round((a.f1 - s.m1)/s.s1, 6) AS f1,
  round((a.f2 - s.m2)/s.s2, 6) AS f2,
  round((a.f3 - s.m3)/s.s3, 6) AS f3,
  round((a.f4 - s.m4)/s.s4, 6) AS f4
FROM allrows a CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY a.row_id
" 2>&1 | tail -20

hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabf15770_featurestore --limit 3 --json "
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT avg(f1) m1, avg(f2) m2, avg(f3) m3, avg(f4) m4,
         stddev_pop(f1) s1, stddev_pop(f2) s2, stddev_pop(f3) s3, stddev_pop(f4) s4
  FROM raw_train_f3dc5_1
),
allrows AS (
  SELECT row_id, 'train' AS split, f1,f2,f3,f4 FROM raw_train_f3dc5_1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT row_id, 'serve' AS split, f1,f2,f3,f4 FROM raw_serve_f3dc5_1
)
SELECT a.row_id, a.split,
  round((a.f1 - s.m1)/s.s1, 6) AS f1,
  round((a.f2 - s.m2)/s.s2, 6) AS f2,
  round((a.f3 - s.m3)/s.s3, 6) AS f3,
  round((a.f4 - s.m4)/s.s4, 6) AS f4
FROM allrows a CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY a.row_id
" 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Test standardization query on delta catalog

tool_input.command:
hops fg create scaled1f3dc5 --version 1 --primary-key row_id --online \
  --features "row_id:string,split:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double" \
  --description "Both splits standardized (train-only population mean/std) as preprocessing" --json 2>&1 | tail -8

mkdir -p .tmp
hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabf15770_featurestore --limit 0 --json "
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT avg(f1) m1, avg(f2) m2, avg(f3) m3, avg(f4) m4,
         stddev_pop(f1) s1, stddev_pop(f2) s2, stddev_pop(f3) s3, stddev_pop(f4) s4
  FROM raw_train_f3dc5_1
),
allrows AS (
  SELECT row_id, 'train' AS split, f1,f2,f3,f4 FROM raw_train_f3dc5_1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT row_id, 'serve' AS split, f1,f2,f3,f4 FROM raw_serve_f3dc5_1
)
SELECT a.row_id, a.split,
  round((a.f1 - s.m1)/s.s1, 6) AS f1,
  round((a.f2 - s.m2)/s.s2, 6) AS f2,
  round((a.f3 - s.m3)/s.s3, 6) AS f3,
  round((a.f4 - s.m4)/s.s4, 6) AS f4
FROM allrows a CROSS JOIN stats s
" 2>/dev/null > .tmp/scaled.json
wc -c .tmp/scaled.json; head -c 80 .tmp/scaled.json; echo; grep -c '"row_id"' .tmp/scaled.json
tool_input.description: Run full query to JSON file

tool_input.command: hops fg insert scaled1f3dc5 --version 1 --file .tmp/scaled.json --json 2>&1 | tail -10
tool_input.description: Insert standardized rows into target FG

tool_input.command: hops fg info scaled1f3dc5 --version 1 --json 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '"name"|version|online|"online_enabled"|primary' | head; echo "---PREVIEW---"; hops fg preview scaled1f3dc5 --version 1 --no-verify 2>/dev/null | tail -15

hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabf15770_featurestore --json "
SELECT split, count(*) n,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN split='train' THEN f1 END),4) tr_m1,
  round(stddev_pop(CASE WHEN split='train' THEN f1 END),4) tr_s1
FROM scaled1f3dc5_1 GROUP BY split" 2>/dev/null | tail -20
